This '''battle''' was the opening battle of the [[Young–Elders War|war]] between [[the Young]] and the [[Elders (Melida/Daan)|Elders]] in [[44 BBY/Legends|44 BBY]]. It started after the Elders attacked the Young when they offered peace.
